description: UK Power Networks Licence Area HV Underground Cables is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Shapefile showing UK Power Networks' high voltage (1kV - 33kV) underground cables. Methodological Approach Data Extraction: Shapefiles are extracted from our geospatial mapping system - NetMap. Vectorisation: Shapefiles will be regularly updated to account for vectorisation updates. Quality Control Statement The data is provided "as is". Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network Infrastructure. The portal shows 2026-04-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Power Networks Shared Data Licence - Connections (https://ukpowernetworks.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/OpenDataPortalLibrary/IQAoqS-OWZGDS5ASk8EwxCETAa5aj8Kx7RISQB6tlPq5-yk?e=6QOYk3). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
